summary: All three easy templates expose a perfect answer-bank-only shortcut. It survives delivery filtering and affects three reproduced stored questions. Package files remain unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Normalize a linear ODE, compute its integrating factor, and select the equivalent product-derivative equation.
reasoning_steps: Identify P and Q after normalizing the leading coefficient.
invariants: The transformed right side equals normalized Q times I.
Exactly one of five radio choices is valid.
permitted_variations: Vary signed elementary coefficients and forcing functions within difficulty.
Vary which offered factor qualifies without assigning correctness a unique bank-shape signature.

source_replay.details: Eight complete source banks replayed. Prompt prose and all six supplied solution templates match. Source omissions and supported corrections are documented.

math.details: Independent symbolic checks verify normalized equations, unique valid choices and displayed solution equations.

variety.details: The same answer-bank relationship predicts 12/12 fresh answers, including 4/4 within each easy template. Numerical and positional changes preserve it.

scope.details: Requested easy output preserves constant-P transformation, five radio choices and source-comparable workload. Authored hard extensions are outside this easy-delivery review.

grading.details: The native learner grader accepts 37 independently verified correct selections and rejects 148 distractors. All fields are radio fields.

rendering.details: Eight actual-UI screenshots inspected; prompts, answer controls and worked solutions render correctly.

packaging.details: Exact dependencies match. Deterministic replay, relocation and boundary rejection pass. Package contents remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Counterfactual mathematical dependencies pass, but bank structure reveals the correct factor without reading the ODE. The shortcut survives publication filtering and remains selectable under positive easy weights.

findings.description: Every authored easy bank contains factors [I,1/I,I²,x,x²]. Select the exponential whose reciprocal and square are also offered; this identifies the correct answer without inspecting P or Q. Successes: 12/12 fresh samples, 5/5 runner records, and all 16 records surviving delivery filtering. Three stored generated easy questions reproduce the defect exactly.
findings.reproduction: From evidence_root run /home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/.venv/bin/python regression-shortcut.py; current generator fails with exit 1. Minimal case: generate('easy', seed=99017, template='signed_constant_power', parameters={'a':'1','n':3}). For y'+y=x³, offered factors are x,e^(2x),x²,e^x,e^(-x); the bank alone singles out e^x. Complete record: minimal-failing-record.json.
findings.requested_change: Change the family-wide easy bank-construction rule so correctness does not always occupy the unique reciprocal-and-square role. Retain the source method, difficulty and five-choice contract. Add controlled cases where changing P makes different candidates qualify within an unchanged bank, and retain the strict failing regression. Shuffling positions or changing coefficients alone is insufficient.
